$comment: Agent hooks are an accelerator, not the enforcement layer. Every command
here calls a script in scripts/, the same script the pre-commit framework and CI call, so
no check is implemented twice. A developer on a tool without hook support
works under identical rules with slower feedback, never weaker rules.
In-session feedback matters because it lets an agent fix a clippy failure
in the same turn while the context is live; catching it at commit time

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" | grep -qE '(/OUT_DIR/|\.pb\.rs$|_generated\.rs$)'; then echo 'Blocked: generated code. Change the generator or the .proto instead. See docs/internal/standards/behavior.md' >&2; exit 2; fi
"$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/check-drift.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'check-drift.sh is failing. Run scripts/check-drift.sh for detail.' >&2
